My family have been a patients at this surgery for many years and have never previously experienced such rude, dismissive, and unhelpful behaviour. When contacted the surgery to request an appointment regarding an ongoing health issue, Alisha refused to assist me properly. She refused to help me with a appointment unless I completed an online survey.

My sister explained to her that I am unable to complete the online survey as I struggle to understand the questions. Despite making this clear, she showed no willingness to help, offer an alternative option, or provide any support. Instead, she repeatedly insisted that I must complete the survey and appeared more interested in ending the call than assisting a patient who was seeking medical help.

I find this behaviour completely unacceptable, particularly from someone working on the front line of a medical practice where patients may be vulnerable or require additional support. Reception staff are often the first point of contact for patients, and they should be expected to show professionalism, patience, and basic respect. Unfortunately, this was not demonstrated at all during my interaction.

Being refused assistance and spoken to in such a dismissive manner has left me extremely disappointed and concerned about how other patients may be treated, especially those who are elderly, vulnerable, or unable to use online systems.

I would like to clarification on how patients who cannot complete online forms are supposed to access medical care at this a patient here for 25 years and it’s fair to say they’ve really gone downhill so I’ve had to leave the surgery. The doctors are not great here, they’re very lazy.

I attended a few times for skin conditions and the doctor didn’t even bother looking at the pictures I submit online nor ask to see in person when I attended, they’re happy to issue you anything without having a look.
